why.title: Why TaxHelp AI Is Different
why.subtitle:
Most tax platforms are built for accountants or high-income users.
We built TaxHelp AI for real people.

items.title: Built for Gig Workers
items.body: DoorDash, UberEats, Lyft, Instacart, Uber, Amazon Flex — automatic mileage, vehicle expenses, tips, and gig-income deductions.

items.title: Built for Immigrants
items.body: Support in 10 languages. Step-by-step assistance with simple explanations — no accounting knowledge required.

items.title: Built for Families
items.body: Automatic Child Tax Credit, Earned Income Credit, dependents, and joint filings.

items.title: Built for Seniors
items.body: Clear and simple help with Social Security (SSA-1099), retirement income, and medical deductions.

items.title: Built for Low-Income Households
items.body: Affordable pricing and free filing for selected groups when grant funding becomes available.

items.question: What is the registration fee for?
items.answer: It provides lifetime access to your account, secure document storage, and basic AI tax guidance.

items.question: When do I pay the filing fees?
items.answer: You only pay when you choose to file your completed tax return.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. All documents and information are fully encrypted and stored securely.

items.question: Can I file taxes for multiple years?
items.answer: Yes. You can upload past documents and file previous years’ returns.

items.question: Do you support all U.S. states?
items.answer: Yes — all states and local jurisdictions are supported.
